components.title: BimmerVision
components.description: The first app to enable continuous recording of BMW’s 360° camera system directly to a USB flash drive on iDrive 7. View the matching side camera in the instrument cluster when you use a blinker. Recording and preview work independently, with blinker-only and navigation options. Direct capture performs no BMW Drive Recorder subscription check; a car without an entitlement has not yet been physically tested. Requires iDrive 7 MGU, 360° Surround View and Cluster renderer 0.6.0+.

components.title: BimmerVision Recorder
components.description: Required recorder service for BimmerVision. Sets up this car automatically; never includes another car’s credentials.
